## Contract and architecture checklist

- [ ] I read `AGENTS.md` and followed the repository rules.
- [ ] I checked `CLAUDE.md` for naming, architecture, and shipped behavior.
- [ ] I checked `docs/architecture/decisions.md` before changing product or platform contracts.
- [ ] Database, shared types, server, UI, adapters, and docs are synchronized where relevant.
- [ ] Company scoping, permissions, approvals, budgets, and audit invariants are preserved.

## Documentation checklist

- [ ] Docs were updated for behavior or command changes.
- [ ] Public docs describe shipped behavior, or planned behavior is clearly labeled.
- [ ] Screenshots or recordings are attached for UI changes when useful.

## Safety checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private local paths, or personal data are committed.
- [ ] No retired brand terms were introduced.
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior is described without public exploit details.
